_design_note: Stages are atomic and reusable. Skeletons compose stage ids into an ordered sequence for a specific (tool, runtime, deployment_target) combo. This avoids storing a full pipeline file per combination — extend by adding stages, not by duplicating whole pipelines.

stage_templates.yaml_skeleton:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4
  with:
    node-version: '{{node_version}}'
    cache: 'npm'
- run: npm ci

- name: Trivy image scan
  uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
  with:
    image-ref: '{{image_ref}}'
    severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
    exit-code: '1'

- name: Build and push image
  run: |
    docker build -t {{image_ref}} .
    echo "{{secret.docker_registry_password}}" | docker login -u {{secret.docker_registry_username}} --password-stdin
    docker push {{image_ref}}
